1. Open LocalSend on both devices.\n2. C:
1. Open LocalSend on both devices.
2. Connect both devices to the same local network.
3. Allow TCP and UDP port 53317 through your firewall (or the port selected in Settings).
4. Disable access-point isolation on guest Wi-Fi.
5. Check that a VPN is not blocking local traffic, then refresh.
